basic_details.job_title: MNNIT Allahabad Part Time General Duty Doctors Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) has announced 12 vacancies for Part Time General Duty Doctors on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply through the offline application process from 12 October 2026 to 2 November 2026 by sending the filled proforma and documents by speed post, registered post or by hand to The Registrar, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad, Prayagraj, with the hard copy reaching by 2 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of all credentials in proof of age, academic qualifications, category, experience, Awards & Honours. Two (02) recent passport size photographs. All relevant certificates for professional qualifications and experience.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selections are made through the recommendations of the Selection Committee based on performance in a personal interview, which is intended to test various aspects of personality quotient, domain knowledge, and suitability for ready deployment for job/assignment with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for permanent positions or contract basis?
faq.answer: These positions of Part Time General Duty Doctors are engagement on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets preference during shortlisting or selection?
faq.answer: Candidates having higher educational qualifications (such as an MD or PG degree/diploma in the concerned specialty, or MPT in Physiotherapy) and relevant work experience will be preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the personal interview?
faq.answer: Where the number of applications is large, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview based on higher educational qualifications, higher experience in the relevant field, or by counting experience before or after acquiring essential qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of all credentials in proof of age, academic qualifications, category, experience, awards and honours, along with two recent passport size photographs.
